claims: The 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Wrestling Championships will be held March 19–21 at Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse in Cleveland, Ohio.
The 2026 NCAA DI Men's Wrestling Championships dates are Thursday, March 19 – Saturday, March 21, 2026.
The 2026 NCAA DI Men's Wrestling Championships location is Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse in Cleveland, Ohio.
The 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Wrestling Championships schedule on Thursday, March 19 includes preliminaries at 12 p.m. Eastern Time.
The 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Wrestling Championships schedule on Thursday, March 19 includes preliminaries and wrestle-backs at 7 p.m. Eastern Time.
The 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Wrestling Championships schedule on Friday, March 20 includes quarterfinals and wrestle-backs at 12 p.m. Eastern Time.
The 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Wrestling Championships schedule on Friday, March 20 includes semifinals and wrestle-backs at 8 p.m. Eastern Time.
The 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Wrestling Championships schedule on Saturday, March 21 includes championship finals.
The 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Wrestling Championships feature 330 wrestlers from 76 teams.
The 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Wrestling Championships have 33 wrestlers in each of ten weight classes from 125 pounds to Heavyweight.
Brackets and seeds for the 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Wrestling Championships were announced on March 11, 2026.
At-large qualifiers for the 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Wrestling Championships were released on March 10, 2026.
Penn State won seven individual titles at the 2026 Big Ten Championships.
Oklahoma State holds the record for most team titles with 34, according to Wikipedia.
The 2026 Division II Wrestling Championships took place March 13–14 at the Denny Sanford PREMIER Center in Sioux Falls, SD.
The 2026 Division III Wrestling Championships were held in Cedar Rapids, Iowa.
Wartburg clinched their 17th team title on March 14 at the 2026 Division III Wrestling Championships, according to USA Wrestling.
